description: The Ninja box (ninja.rs, GitHub #694) loads the app bundle with ?ninja-window=1 and draws the Ninja that the main window runs hidden (NinjaWindow.tsx). It talks to the main window through events, and it has no frame, so its grants are the events, the start of a drag and one app command, ninja_dismiss, which closes the box: a script in that window reaches nothing on disk, no other plugin command and no other app command. The app commands are tied to windows since build.rs declares them in an app manifest (beta issue 167); the main window's set is app-commands.json. On Windows the theme also asks set_title_bar_colors here, which is refused and caught: the box has no title bar to paint. The global-shortcut plugin is granted to no window; Rust registers the key. Spec: docs/internal/plans/ninja-anywhere-694.md
